heroHeadline: Saudi Oil Output at 36-Year Low; Covert Strikes on Iran Revealed; Aramco Posts Record Profits
heroSubtitle: Saudi Arabia's crude production collapsed to 6.77M bpd — lowest since 1990 — as Hormuz closure bites, while Reuters reveals the Kingdom secretly struck Iranian targets in late March. Aramco's Q1 profits paradoxically surged 26% to $33.6 billion on higher war-driven oil prices, even as Vision 2030 FDI fell an estimated 60–70% in Q1 2026.
